"[private value removed]" -Command '$inspectionCode = @'"'
import json
import numpy as np
import trimesh
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from mpl_toolkits.mplot3d.art3d import Poly3DCollection
m=trimesh.load('inspection.stl',force='mesh')
print('mesh_bounds',m.bounds.tolist())
print('mesh_faces',len(m.faces),'watertight',m.is_watertight,'components',len(m.split()),'volume',m.volume)
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(12,7))
ax=fig.add_subplot(111,projection='3d')
tri=m.vertices[m.faces]
norm=m.face_normals
light=np.array([-.4,-.5,1.]);light/=np.linalg.norm(light)
shade=.40+.55*np.clip(norm@light,0,1)
colors=np.column_stack([shade*.75,shade*.83,shade, np.ones(len(shade))])
poly=Poly3DCollection(tri,facecolors=colors,edgecolors='none',linewidths=0)
ax.add_collection3d(poly)
ax.set(xlim=(-56,56),ylim=(-56,56),zlim=(-4,33))
ax.set_box_aspect((112,112,37));ax.view_init(elev=34,azim=-64)
